description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh: 资源所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the resource. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The ID list of the resources. You can specify up to 50 IDs in each request.

description.zh:
资源类型定义。取值范围：

- dedicatedblockstoragecluster：专属块存储集群。
- diskreplicapair：异步复制关系。
- diskreplicagroup：一致性复制组。
description.en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

*   dedicatedblockstoragecluster: dedicated block storage cluster
*   diskreplicapair: replication pair
*   diskreplicagroup: replication pair-consistent group

description.zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项。
description.en: The resource tags. You can specify up to 20 tags.

description.zh: 资源的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The key of tag N to add to the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`.

description.zh: 资源的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The value of tag N to add to the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or contain `http://` or `https://`.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

绑定标签前，阿里云会校验资源已有标签数量。超过限制值后返回报错信息。更多详情，请参见[使用限制](~~25412~~)。
descriptions.en: Before you add tags to a resource, Alibaba Cloud checks the number of existing tags of the resource. If the maximum number of tags is reached, an error message is returned. For more information, see the "Tag limits" section in [Limits](~~25412~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs tag-resources --resource-id pair-cn-c4d2t7f0000 --tag Value=tag-value Key=tag-key --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type diskreplicagroup --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --region cn-hangzhou
